about: Country cards for lives born in United States. Each card is dealt only to them (and a little more often than general cards). Sources are in each card's "src".

events.src: ===================== United States (US) ===================== Student loans: from 1 July 2026 the Repayment Assistance Plan charges a share of income (from a $10 minimum up to 10% of AGI), waives unpaid interest and forgives the rest after 30 years; Public Service Loan Forgiveness clears the balance after 10 years of payments in public or non-profit work (One Big Beautiful Bill Act 2025; NerdWallet; NYC DCWP). A share of about 5% of pay above a small allowance is an ESTIMATE for a typical borrower.

opts.do: sloanInc = { r: .05, th: .2, end: age + 30, pslf: age + 10, waive: 1 }

en..x: Your federal student loans ({a}) are due. The standard plan clears them in 10 years. The Repayment Assistance Plan (from July 2026) takes 1–10% of your income, drops unpaid interest and forgives the rest after 30 years; with Public Service Loan Forgiveness, the balance is cancelled after 10 years of payments in government or non-profit work.
en..rap.s: Payments rise with your pay: about {a} a year at your pay now.

zh..x: 你的联邦学生贷款（{a}）开始要还了。标准方案10年还清。还款援助计划（RAP，2026年7月起）按收入的1–10%还款，免掉未付的利息，30年后剩下的全部免除；若在政府或非营利机构工作，“公共服务贷款减免”在还款10年后免除余额。
zh..rap.s: 还款随收入增加：以现在的收入，每年约{a}。

zht..x: 你的聯邦學生貸款（{a}）開始要還了。標準方案10年還清。還款援助計畫（RAP，2026年7月起）按收入的1–10%還款，免掉未付的利息，30年後剩下的全部免除；若在政府或非營利機構工作，「公共服務貸款減免」在還款10年後免除餘額。
zht..rap.s: 還款隨收入增加：以現在的收入，每年約{a}。

events.src: Cashing out a 401(k): before 59½ a 10% additional tax on top of income tax (IRS); 41.4% of workers leaving a job withdraw money (UBC Sauder study of 162,000 US job changers, via Financial Planning). A 22% income-tax bracket is an ESTIMATE.

out.do: const l = lots.k401, x = l.v * f; l.v -= x; l.tout += x; cash += .68 * x; happy += f > .6 ? 3 : 1; const t = T('us_401k', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.us_401k') }); t.v -= .32 * x; t.note = M('note.us_401k', { a: MN(.32 * x) })

opts.do: out(1)
out(.5)

en..x: You’ve changed jobs, and your old 401(k) holds {a}. You can roll it into an IRA or cash it out; before 59½ the IRS adds a 10% penalty on top of income tax. About 4 in 10 Americans who leave a job take money out.
en..cash.s: You get about {a} after tax and the penalty. Happiness +3.
en..half.s: You get about {a} after tax and the penalty. Happiness +1.
en.note.us_401k: Lost {a} to tax and the penalty

zh..x: 你换了工作，旧的401(k)里有{a}。你可以转进IRA，也可以提现；59岁半之前提取，国税局除了所得税还要罚10%。离职的美国人约有四成会把钱提出来。
zh..cash.s: 扣税和罚款后约拿到{a}。幸福感 +3。
zh..half.s: 扣税和罚款后约拿到{a}。幸福感 +1。

zht..x: 你換了工作，舊的401(k)裡有{a}。你可以轉進IRA，也可以提現；59歲半之前提取，國稅局除了所得稅還要罰10%。離職的美國人約有四成會把錢提出來。
zht..cash.s: 扣稅和罰款後約拿到{a}。幸福感 +3。
zht..half.s: 扣稅和罰款後約拿到{a}。幸福感 +1。

events.src: Medical bills: non-profit hospitals must have a written financial assistance policy and limit charges to eligible patients (IRS, section 501(r)); about 6% of adults owe over $1,000 in medical debt (KFF, Feb 2024). Bill size and the chance of a cut are ESTIMATES.

opts.do: const r = evR('medFight'), cut = r() < .55 ? inR(r(), [.3, .8]) : 0, y = a * (1 - cut); pay(y); happy -= 1; const t = line(); t.v -= y; t.note = M('note.us_medbill', { a: MN(a), b: MN(y) })
const t = line(); rec('us_medbill', a / 3, 3)
pay(a); const t = line(); t.v -= a; t.note = M('note.paid', { a: MN(a) })

en..x: A short hospital stay leaves you with a bill of {a}. Non-profit hospitals must offer financial assistance to patients who qualify, and itemised bills sometimes contain errors. About 1 in 16 American adults owe more than $1,000 in medical debt.
en..fight: Ask for an itemised bill and assistance
en..fight.s: Hours of calls and forms. Happiness −1.
en..fight.h: About half the time the bill is cut by a third or more.
en..plan.s: {a} a year for 3 years, no interest.

zh..x: 住院几天后，你收到{a}的账单。非营利医院必须为符合条件的病人提供经济援助，明细账单有时也会出错。大约每16个美国成年人就有一人背着超过1,000美元的医疗债务。
zh..fight: 要求明细账单并申请援助
zh..fight.s: 打好几个小时电话、填一堆表。幸福感 −1。
zh..fight.h: 大约一半的情况账单能减少三分之一以上。

zht..x: 住院幾天後，你收到{a}的帳單。非營利醫院必須為符合條件的病人提供經濟援助，明細帳單有時也會出錯。大約每16個美國成年人就有一人背著超過1,000美元的醫療債務。
zht..fight: 要求明細帳單並申請援助
zht..fight.s: 打好幾個小時電話、填一堆表。幸福感 −1。
zht..fight.h: 大約一半的情況帳單能減少三分之一以上。

events.src: Credit scores and mortgages: in Nov 2025 a $300,000 30-year loan was offered at about 6.57% APR for scores of 760+ and 7.34% for 620–639 (myFICO data via ConsumerAffairs). The rate changes in the game (−0.3 / +0.4 points) are ESTIMATES.

opts.do: rateAdj = -.003
rateAdj = .004

en..x: Lenders price loans by credit score. On a 30-year mortgage in late 2025, borrowers with 760 or more were offered about 6.6% a year, against 7.3% at 620–639.
en..build.s: A starter card for small buys, paid in full every month.
en..build.h: Your mortgage rate later is about 0.3 points lower.
en..none.h: Your mortgage rate later is about 0.4 points higher.

zh..x: 贷款利率要看信用分数。2025年底的30年房贷，信用分760以上的人利率约6.6%，620–639分的人约7.3%。
zh..build.s: 办一张入门信用卡买小东西，每月全额还清。
zh..build.h: 以后的房贷利率约低0.3个百分点。
zh..none.s: 没有卡，也没有信用记录。
zh..none.h: 以后的房贷利率约高0.4个百分点。

zht..x: 貸款利率要看信用分數。2025年底的30年房貸，信用分760以上的人利率約6.6%，620–639分的人約7.3%。
zht..build.s: 辦一張入門信用卡買小東西，每月全額還清。
zht..build.h: 以後的房貸利率約低0.3個百分點。
zht..none.s: 沒有卡，也沒有信用記錄。
zht..none.h: 以後的房貸利率約高0.4個百分點。

events.src: Social Security: claiming at 62 pays about 70% of the full benefit for those with a full retirement age of 67 (born 1960 or later); each year of delay past 67 adds 8%, to 124% at 70 (SSA, as summarised by Fox and The Motley Fool).

opts.do: penClaim(q[0], q[1], 'us_ss')

en..x: You can claim Social Security from 62 (about 30% less, for life), at 67 (the full amount, for anyone born in 1960 or later), or as late as 70 (24% more).
en..62.s: About {a} a year from age {n}, for life.
en..67.s: About {a} a year from age {n}, for life.
en..70.s: About {a} a year from age {n}, for life.

zh..t: 什么时候领社会保障金
zh..x: 社会保障金最早62岁可以领（终身少约30%），67岁领全额（1960年及以后出生者），最晚70岁领（多24%）。
zh..62.s: 从{n}岁起每年约{a}，终身领取。
zh..67.s: 从{n}岁起每年约{a}，终身领取。
zh..70.s: 从{n}岁起每年约{a}，终身领取。

zht..t: 什麼時候領社會保障金
zht..x: 社會保障金最早62歲可以領（終身少約30%），67歲領全額（1960年及以後出生者），最晚70歲領（多24%）。
zht..62.s: 從{n}歲起每年約{a}，終身領取。
zht..67.s: 從{n}歲起每年約{a}，終身領取。
zht..70.s: 從{n}歲起每年約{a}，終身領取。

events.src: Childcare: the national average price was $13,128 a year in 2024, up from $11,582 in 2023 (Child Care Aware of America, May 2025). The game already counts a child's basic costs, so the card adds the part above them (about 0.25 of a typical wage): an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('us_daycare', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.daycare') }); rec('us_daycare', .25 * B, 4)
tmpPay('us_part', .55, 4, 'trk.parttime'); happy += 2
T('us_daycare', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.daycareF') }); rec('us_daycare', .04 * B, 4); happy -= 1

en..x: Full-time childcare cost $13,128 a year on average in 2024. One of you could cut back to part-time until school starts, or family could help.
en..daycare.s: About {a} a year for 4 years, on top of the usual costs of a child.
en..part.s: About 45% less pay for 4 years. More time at home: Happiness +2.
en..family.s: You help with their costs: about {a} a year. Less freedom: Happiness −1.

zh..x: 2024年全日制托儿平均每年要13,128美元。你们其中一人可以改做兼职到孩子上学，或者请家人帮忙。
zh..daycare.s: 每年约{a}，共4年，养孩子的一般开销另计。
zh..part.s: 4年内工资少约45%。更多时间在家：幸福感 +2。
zh..family.s: 你帮忙负担他们的开销：每年约{a}。自由少了：幸福感 −1。

zht..x: 2024年全日制托育平均每年要13,128美元。你們其中一人可以改做兼職到孩子上學，或者請家人幫忙。
zht..daycare.s: 每年約{a}，共4年，養孩子的一般開銷另計。
zht..part.s: 4年內薪水少約45%。更多時間在家：幸福感 +2。
zht..family.s: 你幫忙負擔他們的開銷：每年約{a}。自由少了：幸福感 −1。

events.src: FHA loans: 3.5% down with a credit score of 580+, an upfront mortgage insurance premium of 1.75% of the loan and an annual premium of 0.55% for the loan's life with under 10% down (HUD Mortgagee Letter 2023-05; Quicken Loans).

opts.ok: liq >= .083 * P || M('e.home.need', { n: MN(.083 * P), h: MN(liq) })
opts.do: buyAt(P, { dp: .035, fee: .0475, r: .0355, n: 30, lk: 'trk.flat' })

en..x: An FHA loan lets you buy with 3.5% down if your credit score is 580 or more, but you pay 1.75% of the loan up front and 0.55% a year in mortgage insurance for the life of the loan. A starter home near you costs {p}.
en..fha.s: {d} up front, then {m} a year for 30 years.
en..wait: Save for a bigger down payment

zh..x: FHA贷款让信用分580以上的人只付3.5%首付就能买房，但要先付贷款额1.75%的房贷保险费，之后整个贷款期间每年再付0.55%。你附近一间入门房子要{p}。

zht..x: FHA貸款讓信用分580以上的人只付3.5%頭期款就能買房，但要先付貸款額1.75%的房貸保險費，之後整個貸款期間每年再付0.55%。你附近一間入門房子要{p}。

events.src: Health Savings Account: with a high-deductible plan, contributions are deductible and growth and medical withdrawals are tax-free (IRS Publication 969). The tax saving (about 25%) and the higher share of each bill you pay are ESTIMATES.

opts.do: yearly('hsa', { amt: a, until: 65, bonus: .25 }, {}, 'trk.hsa'); medCut = 1.15

en..x: At open enrollment you can pick a high-deductible plan with a Health Savings Account: you pay more of each bill before cover starts, but money you put in the HSA is never taxed if it’s spent on health care, and it can be invested.
en..hsa.s: Put about {a} a year in the HSA. You pay more of each medical bill yourself.

zh..x: 开放投保期间，你可以选高自付额保险加健康储蓄账户（HSA）：保险生效前你要多付一些，但存进HSA的钱只要用在医疗上就永远不用缴税，而且可以拿去投资。
zh..hsa.s: 每年存约{a}进HSA。每张医疗账单你要自己多付一些。

zht..x: 開放投保期間，你可以選高自付額保險加健康儲蓄帳戶（HSA）：保險生效前你要多付一些，但存進HSA的錢只要用在醫療上就永遠不用繳稅，而且可以拿去投資。
zht..hsa.s: 每年存約{a}進HSA。每張醫療帳單你要自己多付一些。

events.src: Trading in a car: in Q4 2025, 29.3% of trade-ins toward new cars were worth less than the loan on them, by a record $7,214 on average, and 40.7% of new-car purchases with negative equity were financed over 84 months (Edmunds, via AP and Jalopnik); in Q1 2026, 30.9% and $7,183 (Edmunds, via KOLD). The price of a new SUV ($49,000 ≈ 1.4) and the loan’s interest are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in the United States, $35,000 a year.

opts.do: const old = car.bal || 0; car = { type: 'new', bal: 1.6 * base + old, pay: amort(1.6 * base + old, .06, 7), trk: 'us_trade' }; happy += 3; T('us_trade', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.us_trade') })
spend('us_used', .5 * base, 'trk.us_used'); car.trk = 'us_used'; happy += 1
T('us_keep', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.us_keep') }); rec('us_keep', .04 * base, 4)

en..x: The dealer will take your car in part-exchange for a new SUV. You still owe about $7,000 more on your old car than it is worth, and the dealer offers to roll that into a new 84-month loan.
en..trade: Take the SUV on an 84-month loan
en..trade.s: Payments of about {a} a year for seven years, with what you still owe on the old car added in.
en..trade.h: Happiness +3. A new car loses about a fifth of its value in the first year, so you will owe more than it is worth for years.
en..used: A reliable used car, paid in cash
en.trk.us_trade: A new SUV on an 84-month loan
en.trk.us_used: A used car, paid in cash

zh..x: 车行愿意收你的车，折价换一辆新的SUV。你的旧车还欠着贷款，比车本身值的钱多出大约7,000美元；车行说可以把这笔钱一起并进一笔新的84个月贷款。
zh..trade.s: 每年还款约{a}，还七年，旧车欠的钱也算在里面。
zh..trade.h: 幸福感 +3。新车第一年大约贬值五分之一，所以好几年里你欠的都会比车值的多。
zh..used: 付现金买一辆可靠的二手车

zht..x: 車商願意收你的車，折價換一輛新的SUV。你的舊車還欠著貸款，比車子本身的價值多出大約7,000美元；車商說可以把這筆錢一起併進一筆新的84期貸款。
zht..trade.s: 每年還款約{a}，還七年，舊車欠的錢也算在裡面。
zht..trade.h: 幸福感 +3。新車第一年大約貶值五分之一，所以好幾年裡你欠的都會比車子值的多。
zht..used: 付現金買一輛可靠的二手車

events.src: Long car loans: with 84-month loans the balance stays above the car’s value for years (Edmunds). Amounts are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: pay(car.bal); car.bal = 0; car.pay = 0; happy += 2

en..t: Upside down on the car loan
en..x: A few years in, you still owe {a} on the SUV, more than it would sell for. The interest keeps adding up.
en..pay.s: The same payments until the loan ends.
en..pay.h: Interest runs on for the rest of the loan.

zh..x: 过了几年，那辆SUV还欠着{a}，比卖掉能拿到的钱还多。利息还在一直累积。
zh..pay.s: 同样的金额，一直还到贷款结束。
zh..pay.h: 剩下的贷款期间都还要付利息。

zht..x: 過了幾年，那輛SUV還欠著{a}，比賣掉能拿到的錢還多。利息還在一直累積。
zht..pay.s: 同樣的金額，一直還到貸款結束。
zht..pay.h: 剩下的貸款期間都還要付利息。

events.src: Medicare at 65: the standard Part B premium is $202.90 a month in 2026, up from $185 in 2025 (CMS, Nov 2025). Original Medicare leaves about 20% of most bills to you with no yearly cap; a Medigap policy covers most of that, while Medicare Advantage plans often charge no extra premium but use networks and prior authorisation (Medicare.gov). Medigap premiums (about $2,500 a year) and the share of bills each option pays are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in the United States, $35,000 a year.

opts.do: medPlan('us_gap', .15, .14 * base)
medPlan('us_adv', .4, .07 * base)
medPlan('us_orig', .55, .07 * base)

en..x: You are turning 65 and can join Medicare. Part B costs $202.90 a month in 2026. You can add a Medigap policy to Original Medicare, or pick a Medicare Advantage plan run by an insurer.
en..gap.s: About {a} a year in premiums. Any doctor who takes Medicare.
en..gap.h: Pays about 85% of your medical bills.
en..adv.s: About {a} a year, often no extra premium; you stay in the plan’s network.
en..adv.h: Pays about 60% of your bills; some treatments need the insurer’s approval first.
en..orig.h: Pays about 45%; your 20% share of each bill has no cap.

zh..x: 你快65岁了，可以加入联邦医疗保险Medicare。2026年B部分每月保费202.90美元。你可以在传统Medicare之外加买Medigap补充保险，也可以选保险公司经营的Medicare Advantage方案。
zh..gap.s: 保费每年约{a}。接受Medicare的医生都能看。
zh..gap.h: 大约支付你85%的医疗费用。
zh..adv.s: 每年约{a}，通常不用多付保费；只能在方案的网络内看病。
zh..adv.h: 大约支付60%的费用；有些治疗要先经保险公司批准。
zh..orig.h: 大约支付45%；你自付的两成没有上限。

zht..x: 你快65歲了，可以加入聯邦醫療保險Medicare。2026年B部分每月保費202.90美元。你可以在傳統Medicare之外加買Medigap補充保險，也可以選保險公司經營的Medicare Advantage方案。
zht..gap.s: 保費每年約{a}。接受Medicare的醫生都能看。
zht..gap.h: 大約支付你85%的醫療費用。
zht..adv.s: 每年約{a}，通常不用多付保費；只能在方案的網絡內看病。
zht..adv.h: 大約支付60%的費用；有些治療要先經保險公司核准。
zht..orig.h: 大約支付45%；你自付的兩成沒有上限。

events.src: Health cover after a layoff: COBRA lets you keep your employer’s plan for up to 18 months, paying the full premium plus 2% (US Department of Labor); job-based cover for one person cost $9,325 a year on average in 2025 (KFF Employer Health Benefits Survey 2025). Losing job-based cover opens a special enrolment period on the ACA Marketplace, with subsidies that depend on income (HealthCare.gov). Marketplace costs and the chance of a big bill while uninsured are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in the United States, $35,000 a year.

opts.do: spend('us_cobra', .27 * base, 'trk.us_cobra')
spend('us_aca', .08 * base, 'trk.us_aca')
const t = T('us_unins', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.us_unins') }); if (roll('us_unins') < .12) { pay(.4 * base); t.v -= .4 * base; t.note = M('note.us_unins', { a: MN(.4 * base) }); happy -= 3 }

en..x: You have been laid off, and your health insurance ends with the job. You can keep the same plan through COBRA if you pay the whole premium yourself, or buy a plan on the ACA Marketplace.
en..cobra.h: The same doctors and full cover.
en..aca.s: About {a} for a year, with a subsidy while your income is low.
en..aca.h: Cover nearly as good; you may need new doctors.
en..none.h: About one in eight people runs up a large medical bill before the next job.

zh..x: 你被裁员了，医疗保险也跟着工作一起没了。你可以自己付全额保费，通过COBRA继续保原来的方案，或是在ACA保险市场买一份新的。
zh..aca.s: 一年大约{a}，收入低的时候有补贴。
zh..aca.h: 保障差不多，但可能要换医生。
zh..none.h: 大约八个人里有一个会在找到下份工作前碰上一大笔医疗账单。
zh.trk.us_unins: 没有医疗保险的几个月

zht..x: 你被裁員了，醫療保險也跟著工作一起沒了。你可以自己付全額保費，透過COBRA繼續保原本的方案，或是在ACA保險市場買一份新的。
zht..aca.s: 一年大約{a}，收入低的時候有補貼。
zht..aca.h: 保障差不多，但可能要換醫生。
zht..none.h: 大約八個人裡有一個會在找到下份工作前碰上一大筆醫療帳單。
zht.trk.us_unins: 沒有醫療保險的幾個月

events.src: Moving somewhere cheaper: nine states have no income tax on wages (Alaska, Florida, Nevada, New Hampshire, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Washington and Wyoming; Tax Foundation, 2025), and home prices differ several times over between the dearest and cheapest metro areas (NAR metro home prices, 2025). Pay, living costs and home prices after the move are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in the United States, $35,000 a year.

opts.do: cityMove('us_move', .93, .85, .6, -4); spend('us_movefee', .1 * base, 'trk.us_movefee')

en..x: Your employer will let you keep your job working remotely, on a lower pay scale for cheaper places. Friends who moved to Texas say a house there costs half of what it does here.
en..go.s: About {a} to move, and pay a little lower. Far from family and friends.
en..go.h: Pay about 7% lower, living costs about 15% lower, homes about 40% cheaper; Relationships −4.
en.trk.us_move: Working remotely from a cheaper state

zh..x: 公司同意你远程工作、保住饭碗，只是生活费低的地方工资标准也低一些。搬去得州的朋友说，那里的房子只要这边的一半。
zh..go.s: 搬家大约{a}，工资低一点，离家人朋友也远了。
zh..go.h: 工资低约7%，生活费低约15%，房价便宜约40%；人际关系 −4。
zh.trk.us_move: 在生活费低的州远程工作

zht..x: 公司同意你遠端工作、保住飯碗，只是生活費低的地方薪資標準也低一些。搬去德州的朋友說，那裡的房子只要這邊的一半。
zht..go.s: 搬家大約{a}，薪水低一點，離家人朋友也遠了。
zht..go.h: 薪水低約7%，生活費低約15%，房價便宜約40%；人際關係 −4。
zht.trk.us_move: 在生活費低的州遠端工作

events.src: Game rule: a move far from family can be reversed later. Costs are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: cityMove('us_back', 1 / .93, 1 / .85, 1 / .6, 5); spend('us_movefee2', .1 * base, 'trk.us_movefee2')
T('us_fly', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.us_fly') }); rec('us_fly', .04 * base, 10)
happy -= 1

en..x: You have settled in, but {p} is getting older and you only visit twice a year.
en..back.s: About {a} to move again, and the old prices.
en..back.h: Pay, living costs and home prices go back to what they were; Relationships +5.
en..fly: Fly home every couple of months

zh..x: 你已经安顿下来了，可是{p}年纪越来越大，你一年只回去两次。
zh..back.s: 再搬一次大约{a}，物价也回到以前。
zh..back.h: 工资、生活费和房价都回到以前的水平；人际关系 +5。
zh..fly: 每两三个月飞回去一次

zht..x: 你已經安頓下來了，可是{p}年紀越來越大，你一年只回去兩次。
zht..back.s: 再搬一次大約{a}，物價也回到以前。
zht..back.h: 薪水、生活費和房價都回到以前的水準；人際關係 +5。
zht..fly: 每兩三個月飛回去一次

events.src: Youth sports: families spent an average of $1,016 on a child’s main sport in 2024, 46% more than in 2019 (Aspen Institute Project Play, via ConsumerAffairs); travel teams cost several times more. About 2% of high-school athletes win an athletic scholarship (NCAA). Travel-team costs and the scholarship odds used are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in the United States, $35,000 a year.

opts.do: T('us_travel', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.us_travel') }); rec('us_travel', .12 * base, 5); kidWin(.04, .5); happy -= 1
T('us_recl', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.us_recl') }); rec('us_recl', .03 * base, 5)

en..x: {p} has been picked for a travel soccer team: tournaments in other states most weekends, coaching fees, uniforms and hotels.
en..travel.s: About {a} a year, and most of your weekends.
en..travel.h: Happiness −1 from all the driving; a small chance of a college sports scholarship one day.
en..rec: Keep them in the local league

zh..x: {p}被选进一支巡回赛足球队：几乎每个周末都要去外州比赛，还有教练费、球衣和住宿费。
zh..travel.s: 每年大约{a}，周末也大多泡在球场。
zh..travel.h: 开车奔波让幸福感 −1；将来有一点机会拿到大学体育奖学金。

zht..x: {p}被選進一支巡迴賽足球隊：幾乎每個週末都要去外州比賽，還有教練費、球衣和住宿費。
zht..travel.s: 每年大約{a}，週末也大多泡在球場。
zht..travel.h: 開車奔波讓幸福感 −1；將來有一點機會拿到大學體育獎學金。

events.src: 529 plans: savings grow free of federal tax when spent on education, and many states let you deduct contributions from state income tax (IRS Publication 970; state plans). Average published tuition and fees at a public four-year college were $11,610 a year in-state in 2024-25 (College Board, Trends in College Pricing 2024). The yearly amounts and the tax saving (about 5%) are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in the United States, $35,000 a year.

opts.do: yearly('us_529', { amt: .05 * base, until: age + 16, bonus: .05 }, {}, 'trk.us_529')
yearly('us_529', { amt: .1 * base, until: age + 16, bonus: .05 }, {}, 'trk.us_529')

en..x: Your bank suggests opening a 529 plan for {p}: invested savings that grow tax-free if they are spent on education. Tuition alone at an in-state public college is about $11,610 a year.
en..yes: Put in a little each year
en..yes.s: About {a} a year until they are 18.
en..yes.h: Invested in stocks; your state’s tax deduction adds about 5%.
en..big.s: About {a} a year until they are 18.
en..big.h: Invested in stocks; your state’s tax deduction adds about 5%.

zh..x: 银行建议你替{p}开一个529计划：这笔钱拿去投资，只要用在教育上，增值部分就免税。州内公立大学光学费一年就要大约11,610美元。
zh..yes.h: 投资股票；州税抵扣大约多给5%。
zh..big.h: 投资股票；州税抵扣大约多给5%。

zht..x: 銀行建議你替{p}開一個529計畫：這筆錢拿去投資，只要用在教育上，增值部分就免稅。州內公立大學光學費一年就要大約11,610美元。
zht..yes.h: 投資股票；州稅抵扣大約多給5%。
zht..big.h: 投資股票；州稅抵扣大約多給5%。

events.src: Army Reserve: one weekend a month and two weeks a year; drill pay for a junior soldier is a few thousand dollars a year (DFAS pay tables), and Tuition Assistance pays up to $4,500 a year for courses (U.S. Army). USERRA protects your civilian job while you serve (US Department of Labor). Pay, the skill gained and the chance of being deployed are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in the United States, $35,000 a year.

opts.do: T('us_res', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.us_res') }); rec('us_res', -.12 * base, 6); addSkill('us_res', 3, M('trk.us_ressk')); rl(-1); happy -= 1

en..x: A recruiter at a job fair says the Army Reserve would pay you for one weekend a month and two weeks a year, and help pay for courses.
en..join.s: Drill pay on top of your job; your employer must keep your job for you if you are called up.
en..join.h: Extra pay of about an eighth of a typical wage a year; Skill +3; Happiness and Relationships −1; you could be deployed.

zh..x: 招募人员在招聘会上说，参加陆军预备役每个月一个周末、每年两个星期，都有薪水可拿，还能补助上课的学费。
zh..join.s: 正职之外多一份训练薪水；如果被征召，雇主必须替你保留职位。
zh..join.h: 每年多赚大约八分之一个一般工资；能力 +3；幸福感和人际关系 −1；有可能被派去海外。

zht..x: 招募人員在就業博覽會上說，參加陸軍後備部隊每個月一個週末、每年兩個星期，都有薪水可拿，還能補助上課的學費。
zht..join.s: 正職之外多一份訓練薪水；如果被徵召，雇主必須替你保留職位。
zht..join.h: 每年多賺大約八分之一個一般薪資；能力 +3；幸福感和人際關係 −1；有可能被派去海外。

events.src: Reserve units are mobilised for deployments of up to a year, and employers must rehire returning service members (USERRA, US Department of Labor). Effects are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: happy -= 6; rl(-5); health -= 2; if (roll('us_dep') < .1) health -= 8
pay(.04 * base); happy -= 4; rl(-2); health -= 2; if (roll('us_dep') < .1) health -= 8

en..x: Your Reserve unit is being sent overseas for nine months. Your job will be waiting when you come back.
en..go: Go, and hope all is well at home
en..go.h: Happiness −6, Relationships −5, Health −2; a small chance of an injury.
en..plan: Go, after arranging help at home
en..plan.s: About {a} for someone to look after the bills, the house and the people you leave behind.

zh..x: 你所在的预备役部队要派驻海外九个月。等你回来，工作还会在。
zh..go: 出发，希望家里一切都好
zh..go.h: 幸福感 −6，人际关系 −5，健康 −2；有一点受伤的风险。
zh..plan.s: 花大约{a}请人帮忙照顾账单、房子和家人。

zht..x: 你所在的後備部隊要派駐海外九個月。等你回來，工作還會在。
zht..go: 出發，希望家裡一切都好
zht..go.h: 幸福感 −6，人際關係 −5，健康 −2；有一點受傷的風險。
zht..plan.s: 花大約{a}請人幫忙照顧帳單、房子和家人。

events.src: Flood insurance: standard homeowners policies don’t cover flood damage; cover comes from FEMA’s National Flood Insurance Program or private insurers, usually after a 30-day wait (FEMA). Only a small share of homeowners have it, about 4% nationally (FEMA estimates, widely reported after Hurricane Helene in 2024). Premiums and the cost of preparing are an ESTIMATE; how often a flood or storm reaches you comes from EM-DAT (js/data.js). Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in the United States, $35,000 a year.

en..x: Your homeowners policy, you discover, doesn’t cover flood damage. After Hurricane Helene in 2024, most flooded homes in the mountains of North Carolina had no flood cover.

zh..x: 你这才发现，房屋保险并不赔洪水造成的损失。2024年飓风海伦过后，北卡罗来纳州山区被淹的房子大多没有洪水保险。

zht..x: 你這才發現，房屋保險並不賠洪水造成的損失。2024年颶風海倫過後，北卡羅來納州山區被淹的房子大多沒有洪水保險。

events.src: Community college: average published tuition and fees were $4,050 a year at public two-year colleges and $11,610 in-state at public four-year colleges in 2024-25 (College Board, Trends in College Pricing 2024). Of students who start at a community college, about one in six earns a bachelor’s degree within six years (Community College Research Center, Tracking Transfer, 2024). The fees saved and the chance of not finishing are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in the United States, $35,000 a year.

opts.do: const c = trk.sk_edu ? trk.sk_edu.cost : 0, x = Math.min(.35 * c, .45 * base), y = Math.min(sloan, x); sloan -= y; cash += x - y; if (roll('us_cc') < .3) bump('us_cc', .9, M('trk.us_cc'))

en..x: You have a place at the state university. A counsellor suggests two years at the community college first, at about a third of the tuition, then transferring to finish the degree.
en..cc.s: About a third of the tuition for the first two years.
en..cc.h: Saves on fees and loans, but some credits don’t transfer and some students never finish the degree.
en.trk.us_cc: A degree that stalled after community college

zh..x: 你考上了州立大学。辅导老师建议你先在社区大学读两年，学费只要三分之一左右，再转学完成学位。
zh..cc.s: 前两年学费大约三分之一。
zh..cc.h: 省下学费和贷款，但有些学分转不过去，也有人一直没读完学位。
zh.trk.us_cc: 社区大学之后没读完的学位

zht..x: 你考上了州立大學。輔導老師建議你先在社區大學讀兩年，學費只要三分之一左右，再轉學完成學位。
zht..cc.s: 前兩年學費大約三分之一。
zht..cc.h: 省下學費和貸款，但有些學分轉不過去，也有人一直沒讀完學位。
zht.trk.us_cc: 社區大學之後沒讀完的學位

events.src: 401(k) loans: most plans let you borrow up to half your balance, at most $50,000, repaid with interest into your own account through payroll within five years; if you leave the job, what is left soon falls due or is taxed as a withdrawal, with a 10% penalty before 59½ (IRS). Credit card interest averaged over 20% a year in 2025 (Federal Reserve G.19). The repair bill and the chance of losing the job meanwhile are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in the United States, $35,000 a year.

opts.do: const l = lots.k401; l.v -= x; l.tout += x; yearly('k401', { amt: .22 * x, until: age + 5 }, {}); T('us_kloan', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.us_kloan'), note: M('note.us_kloan', { a: MN(x) }) }); later(age + 2, 'us_kl', { x: x })
pay(x)

later.us_kl: if (!working()) { pay(.2 * x.x); log(M('log.us_kl', { a: MN(.2 * x.x) }), 'bad') }

en..x: The roof needs fixing now, about {a}, and your savings are thin. Your 401(k) lets you borrow from yourself and pay it back from your paycheck.
en..borrow.s: Repay about {b} a year for five years, into your own account.
en..borrow.h: No credit check and the interest goes to you, but the money misses the market meanwhile; if you lose your job, the rest falls due.
en..card: Put it on a credit card
en..card.h: Card interest runs at over 20% a year until it is paid.
en.log.us_kl: You lost your job with a 401(k) loan still open; tax and a penalty on the rest cost {a}.

zh..x: 屋顶现在就得修，大约要{a}，可你的存款不多。401(k)可以让你向自己借钱，再从薪水里慢慢还。
zh..borrow.s: 五年内每年还大约{b}，还进你自己的账户。
zh..borrow.h: 不查信用，利息也付给自己，但这段时间钱不在股市里；要是丢了工作，剩下的要马上还。
zh..card.h: 还清之前，信用卡利息一年超过20%。
zh.log.us_kl: 你丢了工作，401(k)贷款还没还完；剩下的部分被课税加罚款，花掉{a}。

zht..x: 屋頂現在就得修，大約要{a}，可是你的存款不多。401(k)可以讓你向自己借錢，再從薪水裡慢慢還。
zht..borrow.s: 五年內每年還大約{b}，還進你自己的帳戶。
zht..borrow.h: 不查信用，利息也付給自己，但這段時間錢不在股市裡；要是丟了工作，剩下的要馬上還。
zht..card.h: 還清之前，信用卡利息一年超過20%。
zht.log.us_kl: 你丟了工作，401(k)貸款還沒還完；剩下的部分被課稅加罰款，花掉{a}。
